description: This file defines a database migration class `Migration_13_14` for an Android application. It handles transitioning widget preferences stored in shared preferences into a database table during an upgrade from version 13 to 14. The migration involves creating a new table, reading existing shared preferences related to widget configurations, migrating data into the new table with proper handling of legacy settings, and notifying widget components to update.

classes.name: Migration_13_14
classes.description: A class extending Room's Migration to migrate widget preferences from shared preferences into a database table during app upgrade.

methods.name: Migration_13_14
methods.description: Constructor initializing the migration with context, calling superclass constructor for version range.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the migration: creates new table, reads shared preferences for widget configurations, migrates data into the database, cleans up old preferences, and triggers widget updates.
